changes.title: Lighter music
items: The music takes less of your computer's effort to play, sounding the same, so it should keep up on more machines

changes.title: No aggro vignette
items: The red glow round the screen edges when wild animals size you up is gone; the animals themselves still turn red before they attack
Trying to put a sigil down too close to another no longer flashes a dark red circle (a refusal sound is coming instead)

changes.title: Babies join
items: Invite all of an area's young and grown-up animals and its runestone transforms: its babies no longer hold it up, and they join the party when it does
